labels.rationale: Manually audited pinned source: synchronous zero-parameter arrow, no options, one themeState$.customColors.dark.accent.primary.get() read. This supports the bounded direct-input style case. It does not support async selectors, option forwarding, or claims that observer uses the same subscription ownership. Those exclusions are protected by synthetic adversarial fixtures; no such app defect is claimed.

Manually audited selectedIndices$.get().has(index) boolean projection must retain its result filtering. This is not a direct get or literal-only selector. Async wrappers and prototype-setting literals are separately excluded by adversarial fixtures; the pinned app is not asserted to contain them.
